SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: No beeps at night
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Switches are still logged and shown, just without sound.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Full volume for alerts
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Beeps at full alarm volume, even when the phone is on silent.

EditTextPreference.app:title: Flicker limit (%)
EditTextPreference.app:summary: Light wobble above this counts as moteur. Set automatically by the 'It's kahraba / It's moteur' buttons.

EditTextPreference.app:title: Minutes of steady light before calling kahraba

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Careful kahraba detection
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: After a cut, wait until the moteur has flickered at least once (or 3x the steady time) before calling kahraba.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:title: Moteur from flicker alone
SwitchPreferenceCompat.app:summary: Switch to moteur when the light flickers even without a power cut. Off by default because kahraba can wobble too.
